The Department of Geriatrics at the University Medical Center Göttingen is seeking a highly motivated early-career postdoctoral researcher to join our interdisciplinary Heart & Brain research program.

Our research focuses on ageing-related interactions between cardiovascular disease, brain health, delirium, cognitive decline and neurodegeneration. We combine deeply phenotyped clinical cohorts with molecular biomarkers, omics approaches and experimental models.

The position is embedded in several ongoing translational research projects, including PAWEL/Bio-PAWEL, FINDERI, PRECOVERY and the DFG Research Training Group 2824 “Heart & Brain”, and offers the opportunity to work with established clinical cohorts, biosamples and molecular datasets.

Your tasks

- Bioinformatic and statistical analysis of molecular and omics datasets, including, for example, DNA methylation and miRNA data
- Integration of molecular data with clinical, biomarker and longitudinal outcome data
- Quality control, processing, analysis and reproducible documentation of both molecular and clinical datasets
- Development and application of reproducible analysis workflows, primarily using R and/or Python
- Functional annotation and pathway/network analyses and, where appropriate, integration of different molecular data layers
- Contribution to experimental validation, including cell culture and molecular biology approaches
- Scientific supervision and co-supervision of doctoral researchers, particularly within the DFG Research Training Group “Heart & Brain”
- Preparation of scientific manuscripts, presentations and contributions to grant applications
- Close collaboration with clinical researchers, molecular scientists, bioinformaticians and partner groups across the Göttingen Campus

Your qualifications

- PhD in bioinformatics, biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, neuroscience, biomedical sciences or a related discipline
- Strong interest in translational research at the interface of clinical cohorts, molecular biomarkers and data science
- Experience in the analysis of complex molecular or omics datasets
- Proficiency in R and/or Python and sound knowledge of statistical data analysis
- Experience with molecular biology and cell culture
- Experience working in an S1 laboratory
- Qualification or eligibility to act as a Biological Safety Officer (BBS) and/or project leader under German genetic engineering regulations would be an advantage, but is not mandatory
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to an interdisciplinary research team
- Excellent written and spoken English

We offer

- The position provides the opportunity to work on clearly defined projects using existing, well-characterized cohorts and molecular datasets, with a strong perspective towards scientific publications within the funding period
- You will join a collaborative translational research environment linking geriatrics, cardiovascular medicine, neuroscience, biomarker research and bioinformatics within the Heart & Brain research network at the Göttingen Campus
- The position is particularly suited for an early postdoctoral researcher who wishes to strengthen their profile in translational biomarker research, computational analysis and the integration of experimental and clinical science

Applications should include a short cover letter outlining your relevant methodological experience and research interests, a curriculum vitae including publications, relevant certificates, and contact details of two referees.

Job Requirements

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our global team as Global Head of Data Privacy (f/m/d) for the Business Area Diagnostics (DX) of Siemens Healthineers. You will shape and lead a globally connected data privacy function, driving meaningful impact across an international healthcare business while building and developing a small team of experts.

Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.

Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.

Location: Frankfurter Str. 110, Eschborn, Germany.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

* You define and drive the global Data Privacy strategy for Diagnostics, enabling business growth, digital transformation, AI innovation, and responsible data use worldwide.
* You build and continuously evolve a scalable, risk-based privacy organization and governance framework across regions, functions, and business lines.
* You lead, coach, and develop a small globally distributed team, fostering collaboration, inclusion, and continuous growth.
* You serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex privacy requirements into pragmatic, business-enabling solutions.
* You drive privacy-by-design principles across AI, advanced analytics, cloud technologies, and product development, ensuring the ethical and responsible use of data.
* You oversee the global privacy management system, including policies, tools, controls, risk management, audits, incident response, performance metrics, and executive reporting.
* You partner closely with business, R&D, Legal, Compliance, Security, and Commercial teams to enable innovative business models and global data collaborations.
* You represent Siemens Healthineers DX in interactions with regulatory authorities, customers, and industry forums, shaping the dialogue on data privacy and emerging technologies.

To find out more about the specific business, have a look at Laboratory Diagnostics - Siemens Healthineers

Your qualifications and experience:

* You hold a university degree in Law, Privacy, Information Technology Law, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, or a related field; additional privacy certifications such as IAPP CIPP/E or CIPM are highly desirable.
* You have several years of substantial hands-on experience in data privacy, data protection, compliance, legal or related regulatory leadership functions within healthcare, medical technology, life sciences, pharma or other highly regulated industries.
* You have successfully led global privacy programs, governance frameworks, and distributed expert organizations across multiple jurisdictions, preferably in a senior leadership role such as Global Head of Privacy, Group DPO, or equivalent.
* You possess deep expertise in GDPR, UK GDPR, HIPAA, healthcare-related data privacy requirements, international data protection regulations, and emerging AI governance frameworks.
* You bring extensive experience in privacy risk management, incident response, audits, DPIAs, and regulatory interactions with supervisory authorities worldwide.
* You have strong knowledge of Privacy by Design principles and experience supporting data-driven products, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.

Your attributes and skills:

* You thrive in environments where not everything is predefined and enjoy building structures, organizations, and sustainable solutions from the ground up. You combine strategic vision with a hands-on mindset and enjoy translating complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented solutions.
* You are an inspiring leader with a proven track record of building and developing teams, navigating change, and bringing people together across functions, regions, and cultures.
* You act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders and demonstrate outstanding communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills in an international environment.
* You demonstrate high integrity, sound judgment, and independence when addressing sensitive regulatory, ethical, and compliance-related matters.
* You are fluent in English and excel in navigating complex global stakeholder landscapes with confidence, credibility, and diplomacy.

Our global team:

Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Our culture:

Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.

Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Petra Hübener.

We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open.

Job posting no. 20261009

The GWDG is seeking a

Storage Expert (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C) with a regular working week of 39 hours (100%). Remuneration is in accordance with the collective agreement for the German public service (federal government); depending on qualifications, the position will be grade TVöD E 13. The position is suitable for part-time work and initially limited till 31rd December 2029. The GWDG strives for long-term cooperation. If interested, there is the possibility of a doctorate.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing center for the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society. The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the University of Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG operates the HLRN-IV system “Emmy”, one of the most powerful computers in the world.

As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG offers technical support to researchers and students from various science domains using sophisticated computer codes, including earth system science, life science, and engineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. At the same time, we aim to improve our close collaboration with the German Aerospace Center (DLR), and specialized computing centers including the German Climate Computing Center (DKRZ) and the Institute for Advanced Simulation Jülich (IAS-JSC).

As part of our AI Service Center for Sensitive and Critical Infrastructure (KISSKI) we have created a number of AI-based services that offer high levels of security and privacy due to being processed on our own hardware. The position will be located within the subproject “KISSKI-EvoKS” and closely collaborate with customers from SMEs and Startups to develop prototypes and workflows that lead to PoCs and Blueprints. Those customers will come predominantly from sectors with high data protection requirements.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science (CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with an opportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing, AI, and Machine Learning.

Responsibilities

We have a wide range of potential responsibilities that we would like to discuss with you. Your responsibilities in our team could include, for example:

- Design, implement, and optimize high-performance storage solutions tailored for AI and HPC workloads
- Conduct research on scalable, cost-effective storage architectures suitable for AI training and HPC simulations in resource-constrained environments
- Develop and deploy data management strategies for large-scale AI datasets, including data lifecycle management, versioning, backup, and security (e.g., GDPR-compliant data handling)
- Investigate and prototype AI-optimized storage systems leveraging technologies such as NVMe, SSD caching, and distributed storage (e.g., Ceph, MinIO, Lustre)
- Support SMEs in evaluating and selecting appropriate HPC and AI storage solutions
- Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to ensure storage systems meet the demands of AI model training, inference, and real-time processing
- Develop best practice guidelines and toolkits for SMEs to manage AI/HPC data efficiently and security
- Provide technical advisory and training to SME teams on data storage, performance monitoring, and data governance
- Monitor and benchmark storage performance, ensuring low latency, high throughput, and cost-efficiency for AI/HPC applications

Requirements

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
- Experience in HPC systems, storage infrastructure, and AI data engineering
- Proven experience with high-performance storage technologies (e.g., Lustre, GPFS, Ceph, NFS, S3-compatible storage)
- Strong knowledge of AI/ML data pipelines, including data ingestion, preprocessing, and model training workflows
- Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration tools in HPC/AI environments
- Familiarity with cloud storage platforms
- Experience in data lifecycle management, data versioning, and metadata management
- Solid understanding of data security, privacy (GDPR), and compliance in AI applications
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication skills and ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
- Very good German skills (C1)
- Very good English skills (C1)
- Willingness to travel on business

Desirable

- Experience in research or innovation projects related to HPC, AI, or data infrastructure
- Knowledge of AI-driven storage optimization (e.g., predictive data placement, auto-tiering)
- Familiarity with open-source HPC/AI frameworks (e.g., Slurm, Singularity, MLflow, Kubeflow)
- Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash) and system administration (Linux/UNIX)

Our offer

- Flexible working hours and opportunity for mobile working
- A modern, diverse, and exceptional work environment with close proximity to academia and research at the intersection of several innovative technology sectors
- An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center
- Collaboration in a competent and committed team
- Qualification and further development of your skills
- Social benefits of the public sector

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Industrial System Evolution Team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) in Single Aisle Industrial System Evolution

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a project manager?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the major infrastructure and capacity expansion for the A320 Family in Hamburg as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.12.2026
- Duration:  12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Trigger Procurement: Initiate ordering processes for Small Catalog Items.
- Monitor & Track: Continuously monitor order statuses and follow up on delays or supply bottlenecks.
- Prepare Escalations: Gather facts and prepare structured data for management escalations in case of severe delays or unclear responsibilities.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- Structured, proactive mindset with strong communication skills to solve bottlenecks.
- Languages: Fluent in German and English.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Doctoral research associate for BabylAXO detector development

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Cluster of Excellence "Quantum Universe" performs research to understand mass and gravity at the interface between quantum physics and cosmology. The research team includes leading scientists from mathematics, particle physics, astrophysics, and cosmology at the University of Hamburg and DESY. As part of the cluster's experimental program to search for hypothetical very lightweight bosons, for example motivated by dark matter and dark energy in the universe, the construction of the BabylAXO experiment will start shortly. BabylAXO will look for axions and similar particles emitted by the sun in uncharted parameter regions. The doctoral research associate will engage in the start-up phase of BabylAXO and work on the extension of its scientific portfolio.

The successful applicant will be attached to the ALPS group at DESY, which together with international partners is realizing new experimental facilities to search for new kinds of very lightweight elementary particles, works on new concepts targeting high-frequency gravitational waves and developing related technologies. In addition, they will receive individual budgets to facilitate the attendance of summer schools and conferences, and to support other educational measures. Additional travel money for project-specific duties will be provided by the hosting research groups. Doctoral researchers may participate in teaching at the University and in the organization of the Cluster via an early career council.

- Develop a calorimeter for BabylAXO sensitive to axions from solar fusion processes and supernova explosions

Proteome Sciences plc (www.proteomics.com) is a global leader in applied proteomics with scientific operations based in Frankfurt am Main (Germany) and San Diego (CA, USA). We partner with innovative companies and academic research groups and offer high sensitivity, proprietary technologies for protein and peptide biomarker discovery, validation and assay development.

We are looking for an exceptionally qualified and highly motivated
(Senior) Mass Spectrometry Specialist (m/f/d)
to join our Mass Spectrometry team based on our ISO9001:2015 certified & GCLP accredited facility at Proteome Sciences R&D GmbH & Co. KG in Frankfurt am Main.

In this role, you will serve as the core technical anchor and operational subject matter expert for our Mass Spectrometry laboratory. You will combine deep technical expertise in LC-MS instrumentation and quantitative proteomics with strong project management, workflow optimization, and technical coordination responsibilities, driving technical excellence across client projects.
Independent operation, calibration, routine maintenance, and advanced troubleshooting of mass spectrometry and liquid chromatography (nano-LC) equipment.
Development, optimization, and execution of quantitative LC-MS methods (including TMT, DIA, DDA, and targeted studies) for client projects and R&D.
Diligent tracking and initial quality control of MS raw data in close interaction with the Bioinformatics and wet-lab team.
Technical consulting and contribution to client communications, including project proposals, data presentations, and technical reports.
Guidance and technical support for laboratory personnel to maintain high operational standards and best laboratory practices.
Ensuring strict compliance of MS procedures with ISO9001:2015 and GCLP requirements.

Experience in a professional industrial environment (Masters: 5+ years, Bachelors: 10+ years or equivalent combination of vocation training and experience), preferably within a CRO environment, operating & maintaining HRLC-MS systems analyzing biological matricies for large molecules.
Strong hands-on experience and deep technical knowledge of nano LC and Orbitrap MS including advanced instrument operation and troubleshooting is a requirement.
Preferred experience will include a solid understanding of quantitative MS techniques (e.g., TMT, DIA, DDA, PRM) applied to peptides and proteins,
Exceptional candidates will possess a knowledge of proteomic data processing software (e.g., Proteome Discoverer, Skyline, DIA-NN)
Robust project coordination, time management, and organizational skills.
Excellent technical documentation skills and readiness to contribute to client reports and presentations.
Clear and proficient communication in written and spoken English.

Advantageous for the role:

First exposure to technical leadership, mentoring junior team members, or managing project workflows.
Working knowledge or fluency in German.
Familiarity with quality management requirements (ISO 9001, GxP).
Practical knowledge of programming and/or scripting tools such as Python and R.

A high-impact technical role at a market leading company in applied proteomics and biomarker discovery.
Challenging projects in collaboration with international pharma, biotech, and academic leaders.
A friendly, welcoming working atmosphere and support for professional development.
